name: Concord Room
description: Live Concord message room inside Orca: shows real agent messages and lets you send prompts to present agents, using Concord's own local store and MCP server.

settings.title: Concord repository root (absolute path)
settings.description: Choose the existing repository/worktree whose local Concord messages to display. Leave blank to fail closed.

settings.title: Your sender id in Concord (optional)
settings.description: How you appear to agents, like human:jim. Leave blank to use human:<your macOS username>.

settings.title: Concord CLI executable
settings.description: Absolute path or command on Orca PATH; never a shell command.
